title: Two-Anchor Orientation and Token Calibration
objective: Fit the remaining low-parameter calibration (orientation angle + family selection) using ONLY the Wilkes fixed root and the Stonehenge training anchor.

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.r1082.spatialization (bounded 4-family ensemble F1..F4), cwatlas.r1082.wilkes (fixed-root ensemble), cwatlas.r1082.stonehenge_anchor (P17), cwatlas.r1082.partition - NOT reimplemented; pure numpy closed-form solve, no scipy.optimize

implementation.continuous_parameter: orientation angle theta about the body mean-rotation axis (South-Up +Z)
implementation.solve: closed-form single-axis Wahba: theta* = atan2(B, A) with A=sum(cx*tx+cy*ty), B=sum(cx*ty-cy*tx); conditioning = hypot(A,B)
correspondences: WILKES_FIXED_ROOT (root face-centre vs selected Wilkes centroid)
STONEHENGE_PRIVATE_001 (family-mapped route centroid vs synthetic public direction)
implementation.f1_f3_indistinguishable: with the default root face, ROOT_RELATIVE == DIRECT, so F1 and F3 fit identically - two anchors cannot separate them

negative_results: Two anchors under-determine the discrete family choice: the fit NEVER silently picks one. It returns the whole ranked, retained alias set (result_class = CANDIDATE_ALIAS_SET).
refuse_single_measured_pick() raises via claims.refuse_candidate_as_measured - the top-ranked family may not be promoted to a measured selection.
refuse_overparameterized() rejects any fit requesting more free parameters than the 4 scalar constraints the two anchors supply.
A fitted orientation angle is a CALIBRATED_CANDIDATE parameter under a declared family, not a measured fact and not a validated source origin.

claims.statement: One orientation angle is fit against the Wilkes and Stonehenge correspondences for each of the four families (over-determined continuous fit), while the discrete family selection remains under-determined by only two anchors and is retained as a ranked alias set.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public anchors and route shapes only; no private path literals, no personal identity tokens, no raw private vector or narrative
